title: Owner tries each runbook once
goal: The owner follows each runbook once on a test profile or base and pastes the results
acceptance: Pasted back per runbook: the expected results seen, or where a step failed
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: five short trials on a test profile. Not a measurement.
